data: Amazon's operating income was about $36.9 billion in fiscal 2023 ($36,852 million) and roughly $80 billion in fiscal 2025, which works out to an increase of about 117% over the two years. The fiscal 2025 figure is my recollection of the reported results, summing quarterly operating income of about $18.4 billion, $19.2 billion, $17.4 billion and $25.0 billion. I could not check it against the filing here, so please confirm it in Amazon's 10-K. The third quarter of 2025 was reduced by charges such as an FTC settlement and severance costs. For context, fiscal 2024 operating income was about $68.6 billion, so most of the gain came in 2024, with a further rise of roughly 17% in 2025.
